units.upstream: output redirect buffer for an external command is detachable as soon as the command settles
units.api: POSIX only. `$`sh -c ${'"$0" -e "$1" 2>/dev/null & echo hi'} ${BUN} ${grandchildCode} > ${buffer}`.nothrow()` where the grandchild keeps the stdout pipe open (it awaits a gated fetch to a local Bun.serve). While the grandchild still holds the pipe, `buffer.buffer.transfer()` must not detach it (detached === false, or transfer throws). After the gate is released and the command settles: buffer text up to first NUL === "hi\n", exitCode === 0, and a subsequent `buffer.buffer.transfer()` DOES detach it (detached === true), i.e. the pin is released as soon as the promise resolves.
